definitions.explanation: A small amount or number; used to emphasize how small or limited something is.
Very small in degree or amount.

examples.japanese: {僅|わず}か{五分|ごふん}で{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I arrived in just five minutes.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}りは{僅|わず}か{三人|さんにん}だけだった。

notes:
USAGE: {僅|わず}か emphasizes the smallness of quantity, degree, or extent. Can be used adverbially or as a na-adjective (僅かな).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{僅|わず}か〜だけ (only ~, just ~)
・{僅|わず}かな{差|さ} (a slight difference)
・{僅|わず}かに (slightly - adverbial)

CONTRAST:
・{僅|わず}か - emphasizes smallness (slightly formal)
・たった - only, just (casual)
・ほんの - just a little (modest)
